identity.scope: Fixed-KV performance baseline; persistence disabled; not release acceptance. Model payload-equality receipt is a prerequisite.

measurement_notes: Role requests are serial; server metrics are joined by completion token shape and submit time.
Within a two-client pair, identical token shapes make individual completion-order assignment ambiguous; pair aggregates are authoritative, not the per-index attribution.
Fixed global KV capacity 131072 is a performance counterfactual, not automatic-capacity or persistence acceptance.
